summary.text: Trish Ranson is a Democratic member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 34 since November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An educator, she was unopposed in the Democratic primary, which was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Trish Ranson was born in Wichita, Kansas, earned a high school diploma from Ponca City High School, a bachelor's degree from Wichita State University in 1993 and a graduate degree from Oklahoma State University in 2010.
Her career experience includes working as an educator.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she was the music teacher at Westwood Elementary in 2018 before running for office.

Ranson assumed office on November 21, 2018, succeeding Cory Williams, and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Appropriations and Budget Committee, the Select Committee to Review Mental Health Finances and the Health and Human Services Oversight Committee.
In the 2024 survey, she listed public education funding, including teacher pay, and expanded health coverage among her priorities.
